values.quote: stand as a wall for 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by the charge are knocked back/airborne, and the effect resolves over a duration rather than instantly.
mechanics.quote: dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked away}} over 1 second to a line 650 units in front of '''Azir'''.

mechanics.claim: The charge starts partway into the cast time, delaying when damage can land relative to cast.
mechanics.quote: The charge starts at {{fd|0.25}} seconds into the cast time.

mechanics.claim: The ability is not canceled by Azir's death during the cast, so damage can still resolve.
mechanics.quote: ''Emperor's Divide'' will not be canceled if '''Azir''' dies during the cast time.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked entirely by a spell shield.
